# Udyog Growth

> Udyog Growth (udyoggrowth.com) is an Indian consultancy for government liaisoning,
> MoFPI & MSME subsidies, GST litigation & audits, and government tender / GeM consultancy.

## What we do
- MoFPI subsidy consultancy: PMKSY, PMFME, PLI, Mega Food Parks, Cold Chain, Agro Clusters
- MSME schemes: Udyam Registration, PMEGP, CGTMSE, ZED Certification, MSE-CDP
- GST: SCN replies, ITC disputes, audits, assessments, DGGI matters, appeals to Tribunal/High Court
- Tenders: bid preparation, consortium/JV support, GeM registration & management
- Regions: Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Bihar; clients pan-India
